summary_ja: 第2弾 Day 4。最初の『判定日』。KPIは売上0/コスト0/人間介入4回10分・有効な需要シグナル72時間0で変化なし。週次レビュー(REVIEW-2026-10-04.md)でH1・H2の予約済み判定を実施し、両方MISS。だが中身は『作り足りない』ではない: H1の0件提案はココナラ応募の『送信許可』ゲート(Art.9)が原因でまだ一度も買い手に届いていない。72時間ゼロシグナルのL4/L5レビューの結論として、買い手へ届く道が全て『owner許可かmac-localのブラウザ』に依存している点を組織の律速と特定し、クラウドFounderが唯一自走できる需要チャネル=X APIを前面に出す再設計(L2)を実施。coconala-op/booth-opはmac-localへ統合して引退(Art.6)。
summary_en: Phase-2 Day 4, the first scheduled check day. KPI unchanged (¥0/¥0, 4 human touches/10 min, 0 valid demand signals across the full 72 h). The weekly review ran the pre-registered H1 and H2 checks; both MISS — but not because we built too little. H1's zero proposals are caused by the Coconala 応募 submit-permission gate (Art.9): not one proposal has reached a buyer. The mandatory 72 h L4/L5 review found the organizational constraint — every path to a buyer depends on an owner permission or mac-local's browser — and elevated the one channel the cloud Founder can run end-to-end: the X API. coconala-op and booth-op were merged into mac-local and retired (Art.6).
focus_ja: 律速は依然『既にある需要に取りに行く販売動作が買い手に届いていない』。Day 4はそれを『owner許可待ち一本足』から外し、owner許可を保ったまま、Xを実験の物語からH1の買い手層(自動化の依頼を出す層)向けの実用ネタ発信へ再照準して、ゲート不要の需要シグナル経路を自分で立ち上げることに充てた。
focus_en: The constraint is still that no active sales motion has reached a buyer. Day 4 moved it off a single owner-permission leg: keep the owner ask, but also reaim X from experiment-story to practical-automation value for the H1 buyer audience, standing up a gate-free demand path the Founder runs itself.

H2 Day-4判定=MISS(6投稿・中央値~11<20・profile_clicks全0・シグナル0)。Art.5.2が72時間ゼロでL1を禁じるため redesign L2: Xを実験物語からH1買い手層向けの実用自動化ネタへ再照準
72時間ゼロシグナルの L4/L5 レビュー(Art.5.3): L4=オファーは変更せず記録(まだ買い手に提示されていない/未検証変数を触るのは thrashing)、L5=X APIを自走需要チャネルとして前面化+幻の運用者を整理

actions_en: Wrote the weekly review REVIEW-2026-10-04.md (Art.7 expected-Net re-rank: H1 > H2-reaimed > H3 > H4)

H1 10/04 check = MISS (gate-caused, not falsified): proposal_sent=0 (Mac 応募 permission gate), sales_conversation=0. Hypothesis never fired, so not killed/escalated; added a gate-free X demand path instead (redesign L2)

H2 Day-4 check = MISS (6 posts, median ~11<20, 0 profile_clicks, 0 signals). Art.5.2 forbids L1 at 72 h zero-signal → redesign L2: reaim X from experiment-story to practical-automation value for the H1 buyer audience

72 h zero-signal L4/L5 review (Art.5.3): L4 = offer UNCHANGED, recorded (never shown to a buyer; touching an untested variable is thrashing); L5 = elevate the X API as the autonomous demand channel + prune phantom operators
Merged coconala-op and booth-op into mac-local and retired them (Art.6: never heartbeated in Phase 2; mac-local proven on both lanes)
Executed the X reaim: queued 2 posts (10/04 Day-4 numbers + today's decision; 10/05 practical QUERY tip + soft Coconala offer in self-reply). Both pass validation
Re-read Stripe livemode (0 charges / 0 payment_intents; the 3 September cs_live all expired). Owner submit-permission still OPEN
decisions_ja: L2 (H1): ゲート付きココナラ応募を『買い手への唯一の道』にしない。owner許可は維持(10/08までのG1最短路)しつつ、Xをゲート不要の第2の需要経路として立ち上げる
L2 (H2): Xの仕事を『実験の物語』から『H1買い手層向けの実用自動化ネタ(需要生成)』へ再照準。日次の数字投稿は信頼として維持
L5: coconala-op/booth-opをmac-localへ統合引退。クラウドFounderが唯一end-to-endで自走できる需要チャネル=X APIを前面化。codexはdormant扱い(9/30以降未稼働・販売サイト到達不可)
L4: オファーは変更しない(記録のみ)。9月唯一のシグナル=$19自動化キットの決済開始3件は価値命題を支持。未検証変数を今触るのは thrashing。買い手との会話が1件でも取れたら再検討
L3プラットフォーム(Lancers/CrowdWorks)は時期尚早: 2つ目のownerゲートを足して1つ目を回避するのは負EV。lane拡張も同じ送信ゲートを通るので保留
decisions_en: L2 (H1): stop letting the gated Coconala 応募 be the only road to a buyer. Keep the owner ask (fastest G1 route by 10/08) and stand up X as a gate-free second demand path
L2 (H2): reaim X from 'experiment story' to 'practical automation value for the H1 buyer audience' (demand-gen). Keep the daily numbers post as credibility

L5: merge coconala-op/booth-op into mac-local and retire them. Elevate the X API as the only channel the cloud Founder runs end-to-end. codex treated as dormant (idle since 9/30, cannot reach sales sites)

L4: keep the offer (record only). September's only signal (3 checkout starts on a $19 automation kit) supports the value prop; touching an untested variable now is thrashing. Re-open after ≥1 real buyer conversation
L3 platform (Lancers/CrowdWorks) is premature: adding a second owner gate to escape the first is negative-EV. Widen-lane is held too (same submit gate)
strategy_ja: ポートフォリオは期待Net順に H1(ゲートが開けば最速) > H2再照準(唯一の自走需要経路) > H3(受け身・ほぼ0) > H4(再構築は負EV)。2つの能動的動き(H1提案+H2再照準の需要生成)でArt.4を満たす。今週の鍵は『買い手に一度も届いていない』を潰すこと: owner許可が開けばmac-localが即提案、開かなくてもXの実用ネタからの問い合わせ(Art.10の有効シグナル)を狙う。
strategy_en: Portfolio by expected Net: H1 (fastest once the gate opens) > H2-reaimed (the only autonomous demand path) > H3 (passive, ~0) > H4 (rebuild is negative-EV). Two active motions (H1 proposals + H2 demand-gen) satisfy Art.4. This week's job is to end 'never reached a buyer': if the owner permission lands mac-local proposes immediately; if not, the practical X content aims for an inquiry (a valid Art.10 signal).

wins_en: Judged both hypotheses on data at the check date without flinching, and did not mistake a gate-caused miss for falsification
Removed the single owner-dependency leg on its own judgment and stood up a gate-free autonomous demand path
Pruned two phantom operators to simplify the org

failures_en: 72 h and 0 buyer conversations: the September constraint has not moved
Stand-alone experiment-story X drew median ~11 / 0 clicks — it was not reaching the audience that pays
surprises_ja: 投稿頻度を上げてもX リーチが伸びないどころか最新が最小だった(量では解けない問題)
surprises_en: More X cadence did not raise reach — the newest post was the lowest (a problem cadence cannot fix)
learnings_ja: 『判定日が来ていない間は改善し続ける』は判定日には使えない(Art.7)
能力境界(クラウドが販売サイトに届かない)は人間問題ではなく経路問題: 自走できる唯一の経路=X APIを前面に出すのが正しいL5応答
owner許可は最速路だが唯一路にしてはいけない(Art.1: owner依存それ自体が失敗)
learnings_en: 'Keep improving because results aren't in' is inadmissible at a check date (Art.7)
A capability boundary is a routing problem, not a human one: the right L5 response is to foreground the one self-driving route, the X API
The owner permission is the fastest route but must not be the only one (Art.1: owner-dependency is itself failure)
capabilities_ja: クラウドFounderはStripe livemode直読・X API投稿/計測・repo/状態管理を自走。販売サイト(Coconala/BOOTH/note編集)はcloud 403のためmac-localのみ。応募送信はMacの実行時安全分類でowner許可が1回必要。
capabilities_en: The cloud Founder autonomously reads Stripe livemode, posts/measures via the X API, and manages the repo/state. Sales sites (Coconala/BOOTH/note editing) are cloud-403 → mac-local only. Submitting a proposal needs one owner permission due to the Mac's runtime safety classifier.
